title: Pick list
purpose: Preview and print the list of a request's allocated specimens in the order to walk the store.
summary: Preview and print a request's allocated specimens in the order to walk the store.
good_to_know: A pick list is a printout, not a record. Each pick is recorded with Pick specimens.
Specimens not in storage are listed last.
Each PDF produced is noted on the request.

sections.title: What the page shows
paragraphs: Every role can read it. The specimens allocated to the request and not yet picked, in walking order: site, room, storage unit, rack slots, box and position, with specimens not in storage last. Each row shows the specimen ID, type, amount on hand, location, the consent restrictions text and anything that would refuse picking it now. Locations are as recorded when the page is shown.
A pick list is a printout, not a record. Picking is recorded with Pick specimens, which checks every specimen again.
The PDF ends with a Sign-off block (Picked by, Checked by, Date and time) to complete by hand; it is a printout, and each pick is still recorded in the application.

items.label: Download PDF
items.description: Produces an A4 PDF of the same list with a tick box per specimen. Each PDF produced is recorded on the request with who generated it and how many specimens it lists; printing itself is not recorded. If the PDF cannot be produced on the server, the page says so.

items.label: Pick specimens
items.description: Technicians and above: opens the pick grid.

items.label: Nothing to pick
items.description: No specimens of the request are allocated and waiting to be picked.
